model.name: Sunburst sizes render human-readable (B/kB/MB/GB/TB), not raw bytes — legend and center
model.description: Tron (screenshot @v0.8.165, room Files folder detail): the sunburst LEGEND currently renders RAW BYTES — his own values 10916416, 43, 4717922, 1, 1 — and he wants them human-formatted: bytes -> kB -> MB -> GB -> TB, so 10916416 shows as ~10.9 MB and 43 stays 43 B. ROUNDING (derived from HIS stated value 10916416 -> 10.9 MB = SI 1000-based, since 10916416/1e6=10.92): units are SI (1 kB=1000 B, 1 MB=1e6, etc.), 1 decimal place for kB and above, integer for B (43 B, 1 B). Applies to the legend AND the centre total (R40.79). Screenshot = acceptance.

discoverySource.evidence: Tron screenshot of room Files folder detail @v0.8.165 (screenshot = acceptance, standing law tron-information-authoritative)

model.crossRefNote: Format rule for the R37.21 sunburst; applies to the legend and the R40.79 center-total. R40.80 owns the FORMAT; R40.79 owns the center element.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED — OPEN (Tron screenshot shows raw bytes 10916416/43/... in legend); 0 Done till Tron; screenshot-@390 verifies.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On 390px, the legend shows human-readable sizes, NOT raw bytes. Screenshot: 10916416 renders as '10.9 MB', 43 as '43 B', 4717922 as '4.7 MB', 1 as '1 B' — his exact values, human-formatted.

The format is SI (1000-based): 1 kB=1000 B, 1 MB=1e6 B, GB=1e9, TB=1e12; 1 decimal place for kB and above, integer for B. Derived from Tron's own 10916416->10.9 MB. Rounding is stated so the screenshot check is unambiguous.
The same human format applies to BOTH the legend AND the centre total (R40.79) — no surface shows raw bytes. Screenshot: neither the legend nor the centre shows a raw byte count.

DRY (Tron standing law): ONE size formatter renders the human-readable size EVERYWHERE — the sunburst CENTRE total (R40.79), the LEGEND per-file sizes, and ANY size rendered elsewhere in the product. NOT one formatter for the centre and another for the legend. If two call sites can EVER disagree about how 10916416 renders, we have failed => a second size-format impl => RED. Check-before-create: extend the existing formatter if one exists, do not add a rival.

model.drySingleFormatter: Tron DRY standing law 2026-09-02: this human-readable size formatter is the SINGLE product-wide size formatter (centre + legend + everywhere). R40.79 center MUST call this, not reimplement.
